name.description: The entry's name, its folder's, as a machine's `service:` writes it (`nginx`).

description.description: What it is, in a sentence or two, for the generated catalogue page.

licence.description: The software's licence, recorded for the catalogue page.

releases.description: The releases a machine may ask for (`service: nginx@1.30`), each with its OSes.

default.description:
The release `service: <name>` resolves to: one of `releases`, pinned, so a lab never
changes under its author when a newer release is added.

images.description:
The official images, by OS: an image reference with `{{ version }}`
(`docker.io/library/nginx:{{ version }}-trixie`), only where the image's OS is that OS.

settings.description: The settings a machine gives in `with:`, by name: the schema of `with:`.

ports.description: The machine's ports, by name: a fixed number, or a `port` setting's.

data.description:
Data that persists, by name: its absolute path, the same in both forms (the machine's
volumes).

health.description:
When the service counts as healthy beyond its ports answering (the spec's
`healthcheck`).

daemons.description: The daemons the entry runs, by the key a `service` step names: added to the daemon table.

image.description: How the settings reach the official image, when the entry has one.

recipe.description: The recipe: `install`, `configure` and `start`, each a list of steps.

description: An Isoloom catalogue entry: a service, its releases, the settings of `with:`, its ports, daemons and recipe (written by hand).
title: entry.yml

software.description: The software's licence, as an SPDX expression (`BSD-2-Clause`).

notes.description: What else to know (the images bundle their base distribution's packages).

Licence.description: The licence of what an entry installs.

version.description:
The upstream version: exact for `vendor` and `download` (`1.30.6`), the series for
`distro` (`2.4`).

channel.description: Its upstream channel (`stable`, `mainline`, `lts`), when upstream has several.

source.description: Where the VM form installs it from.

os.description:
The OSes it runs on, each in full (`debian@12`): its first is the one the parity
contract's exit run uses.

vars.description: Variables its recipe reads as `{{ vars.<name> }}`.

oneOf.description:
The vendor's own package repository, pinned to an exact version (`lock.yml` holds each
OS's package version string).
The OS's own packages: pinned to a series, since the archive moves within it.
A pinned archive (a `file` step with `url` and `sha256`).

Os.description: An OS as `<family>@<version>` (`debian@12`, `windows-server@2022`), or the family alone for its pinned default version (`debian` is `debian@12`).

description.description: What it sets, for editors and the catalogue page.

default.description:
Its value when `with:` leaves it out. A setting with neither `required` nor `default` is
optional: unset, `when: { unset: <setting> }` holds.

pattern.description: A `string`'s rule, a regular expression the whole value matches.

items.description: A `list`'s item: its fields, by name, each a setting of any type but `list`.

oneOf.description: Text: in a template, it needs a `pattern` or `values`.
A whole number.
`true` or `false`.
A port number, 1 to 65535: a port of `ports:` may take its number from it.

`<machine>:<port>` (the machine's address on a network it shares with this one), or
`<address>:<port>`.
A folder of the project (`site/`).
A file of the project (`nginx/site.conf`).

A literal (lab content), `{ secret: <name> }` or `{ input: <NAME> }`: a value file at
`/run/isoloom/with/<setting>`, reached as `{{ with.<setting>.path }}`.
A list of items, each a map of `items`' fields: a step repeats for each with `for_each`.

SettingType.description: What a setting holds, and how it reaches the machine.

port.description: Its number, when it is fixed.

EntryPort.description: One of an entry's ports: its number, and what it speaks.

oneOf.description: TCP, the default: probed by connecting.
UDP (DNS, SNMP, TFTP): nothing waits for it and no derived check probes it.
HTTP over TCP: derived checks request a page.
HTTPS over TCP: derived checks request a page over TLS, certificates unchecked.
TLS over TCP (not HTTP): probes speak TLS, certificates unchecked.

PortProtocol.description: What a port speaks: TCP or UDP, and for TCP whether probes and checks speak HTTP or TLS.

test.description:
A command run inside the machine: healthy when it exits with 0 (exactly one of `test`
and `http`).

http.description: A page the machine serves: healthy when it answers with a 2xx or 3xx status.

interval.description: The time between two tries (`5s`, `1m30s`). Default: 5s.

timeout.description: How long one try may take. Default: 3s.

retries.description: Failed tries in a row before the machine counts as unhealthy. Default: 60.

start_period.description: A grace period after start before the first try counts (`30s`). Default: 10s.

Healthcheck.description:
When a machine counts as healthy, besides its ports answering: a command that succeeds, or
a page that answers.

anyOf.description:
A text run by the machine's shell (`/bin/sh -c`; PowerShell on a Windows VM), with its
variables, pipes and `&&`.
Arguments run as they are, the program first (no shell in between).

CommandLine.description: A command line: a text the shell runs, or a list of arguments run as they are.

port.description: The port it is served on: a declared port's name or a number.

HealthPage.description: A page a healthcheck requests on the machine itself.

anyOf.description: One of the machine's ports, by name.

PortRef.description: A port a healthcheck names: one of the machine's ports by name, or a port number.

unit.description:
Its unit: one name on every Linux family, or a name per family (`{ debian: ssh, redhat:
sshd, alpine: sshd }`), which also says the families it exists on.

package.description:
The package that ships it, one name or per family: a recipe that installs it without a
`service` step for the daemon gets a warning.

foreground.description:
Its foreground form: what a container's runner `exec`s (`[nginx, -g, "daemon off;"]`),
one on every Linux family or one per family.

user.description: The user it drops to in a container (default root).

logs.description: Its log files, each linked to the container's `stdout` or `stderr`.

anyOf.description: Per family: `debian` (Debian, Ubuntu, Kali), `redhat` (Rocky, AlmaLinux, Fedora, CentOS), `alpine`, `windows`.
Per family: `debian` (Debian, Ubuntu, Kali), `redhat` (Rocky, AlmaLinux, Fedora, CentOS), `alpine`, `windows`.
Per family: `debian` (Debian, Ubuntu, Kali), `redhat` (Rocky, AlmaLinux, Fedora, CentOS), `alpine`, `windows`.

oneOf.description: Standard output.
Standard error.

environment.description:
Environment variables the image reads, each a text with placeholders
(`POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: "{{ with.password.path }}"`).

files.description:
Paths in the image filled from a `folder` or `file` setting
(`/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d: "{{ with.init }}"`).

command.description: The image's command, in place of its own (its arguments), with placeholders.

start.description:
Who runs the `start` steps: the image's own entrypoint (`image`, the default), or
Isoloom's runner before it (`run`).

ImageUse.description:
How the settings reach the official image (design §4.5): its own entrypoint reads variables
and files, or Isoloom's runner runs the recipe's `start` steps first.

oneOf.description: The image's own entrypoint, fed by `environment` and `files`.

Isoloom's runner runs the recipe's `start` steps, then `exec`s the image's own
entrypoint and command (recorded in `lock.yml`).

ImageStart.description: Who prepares the official image at each start.

install.description: Installs the service: skipped on the official image's form, which is this phase.

configure.description: Configures it, in every form (on the official image, as a thin build over it).

start.description:
Prepares each start: host keys, a first-start database, passwords from secrets. Runs
before the services at each start, with the secrets and inputs as files.

Recipe.description: The recipe, phase by phase, in the order they run.

EntryStep.description: A step of the configuration model (the spec's `app.steps`: `reboot`, or a map with one kind key), its texts holding `{{ version }}`, `{{ os.* }}`, `{{ vars.* }}`, `{{ with.* }}` and `{{ item.* }}`. A repository's `key` may be `{ url, fingerprint }`: the refresh pins its SHA-256 in lock.yml.

for_each.description: A list setting: the step repeats for each of its items, with `{{ item.<field> }}`.

family.description: The machine's OS family, as `os:` writes it (`debian`, `ubuntu`, `rocky`, `alpine`).

release.description: The release: a channel (`mainline`) or a version or its prefix (`1.30`).

set.description: A setting `with:` gives (or that has a default).

unset.description: A setting `with:` leaves out, with no default.

When.description:
Where an entry's step applies: every condition given holds (a list holds when one of its
values does). Never the form: both forms run the same recipe.
